literal_meaning: এ পাশে-ও পাশে করা (this side-that side to do)
figurative_meaning_en: to toss and turn in pain or agony
example_sentences_in_bangla: পেটের ব্যথায় সে সারা রাত এপাশ-ওপাশ করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He tossed and turned all night due to stomach pain.
The boy is writhing in bed from illness.
note: This idiom vividly describes physical restlessness due to pain, commonly used in spoken Bengali to express suffering.
